rules.name: dep_supply
rules.why: deposit mints exactly what it reports

rules.name: dep_mine
rules.expr: called("deposit") and ok and post("shares", sender) != pre("shares", sender) + ret

rules.name: wd_assets
rules.why: withdraw pays out exactly what it reports

rules.name: wd_mine
rules.expr: called("withdraw") and ok and post("shares", sender) + arg(0) != pre("shares", sender)

rules.name: fair_out
rules.why: never pays more than the fair fraction

rules.name: fair_out_floor
rules.expr: called("withdraw") and ok and wide(ret + 1) * pre("totalSupply") <= wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalAssets")
rules.why: never short-changes by a whole unit

rules.name: fair_in
rules.expr: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret) * pre("totalAssets") > wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")

rules.name: fair_in_floor
rules.expr: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret + 1) * pre("totalAssets") <= wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")
rules.why: never mints a whole share too few

rules.name: price
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("totalAssets")) * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("totalAssets")) * post("totalSupply")

rules.name: exit
rules.why: you can always withdraw your own shares

rules.name: enter

params.condition: arg(0) > 0 and (pre("totalSupply") == 0 or wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply") >= pre("totalAssets"))

rules.why: a deposit worth a share goes through
